categories.name: Laptops
categories.blurb: Thin ones for the train, big ones for the desk, and two that game.

categories.name: Phones & tablets
categories.blurb: Phones in three sizes, tablets in two, and a watch that goes with them.

categories.name: Audio
categories.blurb: Headphones, earbuds and speakers that sound better than their price.

categories.name: Cameras
categories.blurb: A mirrorless system, a lens for it, and cameras that go places.

categories.name: TV & monitors
categories.blurb: Monitors for work, screens for the living room, and a projector.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.blurb: What goes on the desk, in the bag and behind the router.

products.name: Aero 14
products.blurb: A 14-inch laptop at 1.2 kg with a day of battery: the one most of us would pick.
products.review: Light, quiet, and the battery really does last a working day.

products.name: Aero 16 Pro
products.blurb: The 16-inch one for video and code: a bright screen, a big battery and all the ports.
products.review: Exports in half the time of my old machine. The fans stay quiet unless you push it.

products.name: Nomad 13
products.blurb: Small, blue and cheerful; it fits in a bag with room for the bag's other things.
products.review: Perfect for writing and the web. I would not edit video on it.

products.name: Forge 17
products.blurb: A 17-inch gaming laptop with a 240 Hz screen and a graphics card that earns its fans.
products.review: Everything at max settings. It is heavy and it is loud, and I knew that.

products.name: Slate 15
products.blurb: The sensible 15-inch laptop: a full keyboard, a good screen, nothing to argue about.
products.review: Does what a laptop does. The speakers are the weak point.

products.name: Zen 12
products.blurb: A 12-inch laptop in white that folds flat and takes a pen.
products.review: I take notes on it in meetings and nobody notices it is a laptop.

products.name: Pulse 8
products.blurb: The phone in the middle: a 6.1-inch screen, two cameras, five years of updates.
products.review: The camera is the reason to buy it. The battery gets me to bedtime.

products.name: Pulse 8 Mini
products.blurb: The same phone, 5.4 inches, for one hand and a small pocket.
products.review: Finally a small phone that is not a compromise. Battery is a day, no more.

products.name: Pulse 8 Max
products.blurb: The big one: 6.7 inches, a zoom lens, and a battery for two days.
products.review: The zoom is real. It is too big for my jeans and I bought it anyway.

products.name: Folio 11
products.blurb: An 11-inch tablet for reading, drawing and the sofa, with a keyboard sold beside it.
products.review: Replaced my second laptop. Drawing on it is a joy.

products.name: Folio 8
products.blurb: The small tablet: 8 inches, for books, recipes and the back seat.
products.review: The kids' tablet. Survived a year so far.

products.name: Orbit watch
products.blurb: A watch that counts steps, heart beats and sleep, and shows who is calling.
products.review: Seven days of battery is the whole point. The sleep tracking is kind.

products.name: Hush 700
products.blurb: Over-ear headphones that cancel the train, the office and the open plan.
products.review: I hear nothing of the plane. Comfortable for the whole flight.

products.name: Hush Lite
products.blurb: The lighter Hush: on-ear, white, with most of the quiet for half the price.
products.review: Great value. The band presses a little after three hours.

products.name: Beat Buds
products.blurb: Earbuds that stay in while you run and cancel the gym's music.
products.review: Stayed in through a half marathon. The case is tiny.

products.name: Pebble speaker
products.blurb: A speaker the size of a can that fills a kitchen and survives the rain.
products.review: Louder than it looks. Lives on the balcony all summer.

products.name: Pebble XL
products.blurb: The big Pebble: for the garden, the garage and the whole party.
products.review: The bass surprised everyone at the barbecue.

products.name: Cove soundbar
products.blurb: A soundbar that makes films sound like films, with a subwoofer in the box.
products.review: Dialogue is clear at last. Setup was two cables.

products.name: Lumen M1
products.blurb: A mirrorless camera with a 26-megapixel sensor and a viewfinder you will want to use.
products.review: The autofocus finds eyes in the dark. I sold my DSLR.

products.name: Lumen M1 with 18-55
products.blurb: The same camera with the lens most people start with.
products.review: The kit lens is better than kit lenses usually are.

products.name: Lumen 35 mm f/1.4
products.blurb: The lens that stays on the camera: fast, sharp, and small.
products.review: Bokeh for days. Sharp wide open.

products.name: Trek action cam
products.blurb: A camera for the helmet, the handlebar and the sea: 5K, waterproof to 10 m without a case.
products.review: The stabilisation is unreal. Mounts fit the old ones.

products.name: Skyline drone
products.blurb: A 249-gram drone with a 4K camera, 34 minutes in the air and no licence needed.
products.review: Folds to the size of a phone. Footage looks like a film.

products.name: Snap instant camera
products.blurb: A camera that prints the picture in a minute: for parties, fridges and grandparents.
products.review: Everyone wants one at the wedding. Film is the real cost.

products.name: Vista 27
products.blurb: A 27-inch 1440p monitor for work, with USB-C that charges the laptop.
products.review: One cable to the laptop. Colours are accurate out of the box.

products.name: Vista 32 4K
products.blurb: A 32-inch 4K monitor: two documents side by side, or one photo at full size.
products.review: Text is razor sharp. Needs a big desk.

products.name: Ultra 34 curved
products.blurb: An ultrawide 34-inch screen that replaces two monitors and the gap between them.
products.review: Spreadsheets as far as the eye can see. Games are immersive.

products.name: Cinema 55
products.blurb: A 55-inch 4K television with the apps built in and a remote you can find in the dark.
products.review: Bright enough for a sunny room. The remote glows.

products.name: Cinema 65
products.blurb: The 65-inch Cinema, for a wall and a sofa that face each other.
products.review: Two people carried it in. Worth every centimetre.

products.name: Beam projector
products.blurb: A projector that throws 100 inches onto a white wall and fits in a drawer afterwards.
products.review: Film night on the garage wall. Needs a dark room.

products.name: Key65 keyboard
products.blurb: A compact mechanical keyboard with quiet switches and a cable you can unplug.
products.review: Typing feels expensive. Colleagues did not complain about the noise.

products.name: Glide mouse
products.blurb: A wireless mouse shaped for a hand, with a wheel that spins free when you want it to.
products.review: My wrist thanks me. The free-spinning wheel is addictive.

products.name: Hub 7-in-1
products.blurb: One USB-C plug, seven ports: HDMI, three USB, two cards and power through.

specs.Ports: HDMI 4K 60, 3× USB-A, SD, microSD, USB-C PD 100 W

products.review: Lives on the laptop. HDMI at 60 Hz, as promised.

products.name: Volt 65 charger
products.blurb: A 65-watt charger the size of a plug, with two USB-C ports and folding pins.
products.review: Charges the laptop and the phone at once. Replaced two bricks.

products.name: Mesh 6 router
products.blurb: A Wi-Fi 6 router for a whole flat, and a second one for a house.
products.review: Dead spots gone. Setup took ten minutes.

products.name: Vault 1 TB SSD
products.blurb: A pocket SSD that copies a film in seconds and survives a fall off the desk.
products.review: Fast and tiny. On a lanyard now so I stop losing it.
